cues.text: The road south, late morning. Everyone has slept in a bed and eaten Maddy Fenn's porridge, and it shows.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: A bed, Big Man. An actual bed. I could take on a whole goblin warren today.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Don't say that. Milestone six. Four to the mill.

cues.speaker: oriel
cues.text: Do you count everything, Brannoc?

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Most things.
Pell comes back out of the sky hooting hard and lands on Ilsevel's shoulder. She closes her eyes.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: Goblins. In the hamlet, at the door of the watermill. Four of them, with a log. The people are inside.
The wind brings it to the rest of them a moment later: shouting, and the slow, heavy thud of wood on wood.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: No time to creep. Run.
Brannoc's mail drags at him and Tamsin's legs were not built for this. But Oriel keeps the pace and, to everyone's surprise, so does Ilsevel.
The mill yard. Four goblins and a log for a ram; the mill door splintered but holding; a pale face at the window.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Four. One gate. Get behind me.
Then the yard is quiet. Somewhere inside the mill, somebody is crying with relief.

cues.speaker: oriel
cues.text: Tamsin! You're bleeding again.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: Still mostly on the inside, Sunshine. Mostly.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Ilsevel. The darts. Good work.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: Magic Missile. It never misses. That is rather the point of it.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Four down. Nobody else hurt bad. Good.

battle_narration.text: They make the yard gate before a single goblin looks round. Then one does.
A scimitar finds the gap under Brannoc's arm. He grunts, and does not step back.
Two blades at once, and Tamsin's knees buckle.
Tamsin gets low, gets close, and the first goblin folds.
Ilsevel's fire bolt catches the runt square in the chest.
Oriel's word reaches Tamsin across the yard, and the colour comes back into her face.
Brannoc draws one long breath and straightens. Whatever it costs him, he is not done.
Three silver darts leave Ilsevel's fingers, and the yard is still.

cues.speaker: miller
cues.text: Bless you. Bless every one of you. Ned Hollis; this is my mill. I thought we were done for.

cues.speaker: miller
cues.text: They came at dawn for the grain. Kept shouting that the boss wants meal. Sacks and sacks of it.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: Meal. The goblin in Brindle Cross said they are paid in sacks of meal.

cues.speaker: miller
cues.text: But Bet! My Bet and the lad went out to the barn for the cow, before they came!
Black smoke is pouring off the barn roof. Somebody put a torch to it while the yard was busy.

cues.speaker: tamsin
cues.text: That's no accident. Someone's round the back.

cues.speaker: ilsevel
cues.text: There are voices behind the smoke. Goblin voices. And one deeper than the rest, giving orders.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Ned. Back inside. Bar the door.
The barn doors are barred from the outside with a cart-pole. Inside, a woman is coughing and a cow is screaming.

cues.speaker: oriel
cues.text: Bet! Bet, we're here! Hold on!
Then the shouting behind the smoke stops. All at once. As if someone has just noticed them.

cues.speaker: brannoc
cues.text: Get those doors open. I'll watch the smoke.

next_time: Fire, smoke, and something bigger than a goblin.
